ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with a low macro-level ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels estimated at less than 10%, concentrated primarily at the fluke tips and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark pigmentation across the majority of the fluke surface; high-contrast white circular blobs are spatially localized at the far lateral distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 65 degrees at the intersection of the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge boundary containing a high frequency of sawtooth-like peaks and valleys with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curve extending laterally from the central notch to the acute, upward-pointing distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (barnacle scars/attachments) detected on the extreme distal edges of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two prominent, parallel horizontal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) approximately 40-60 pixels in length visible on the medial region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct parallel rake marks on the left lobe and significant irregular erosion/chipping along the trailing edge boundaries.
other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity white pixel region at the bottom center representing water spray and turbulence, obscuring the insertion point of the fluke into the peduncle.
